sentence: Shed the bunnion before the balledge dropout empties your whole floor.

wombos.definition: A breakdown caused by holding too much specialized knowledge (balledge) at once — dropping it all and crashing out under the weight.
wombos.example: He had a full balledge dropout trying to explain the entire lore in one breath.

wombos.definition: A bunk opinion — a take that is poorly reasoned, unfounded, or just wrong. The opposite of a goonion.
wombos.example: Can't stand that guy — every word out of his mouth is a bunnion.
